ShortDescription.Value: Customize the Cities: Skylines II UI theme (colors, fonts, spacing and more) from an in-game panel, with Simple and Advanced modes, built-in presets, and import/export.

Publish.LongDescription:
# ExtraUITheme
ExtraUITheme lets you customize the look of the Cities: Skylines II UI directly from an in-game panel, by editing the game's CSS custom properties (colors, spacing, radii, and more) instead of hand-editing files.
Requires [ExtraLib](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/75724/Windows) as a dependency.
# Features * Simple mode — the game's colors grouped into a short palette: change one color and every related variable follows. Hover a color to see where it's used in the game UI. * Advanced mode — every :root-overridable variable exposed as a flat, searchable list. * Built-in presets — ready-made themes you can apply instantly. * Custom themes — fork, rename, clone, and save your own themes. * Undo / Redo — step back and forward through your theme edits with Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, rebindable in Settings. * Shared themes — automatically load themes bundled by other mods, alongside your own. * Import / Export — share themes as plain JSON.
# Translation ⚠️ This mod uses Crowdin so there may be inconsistencies with translations due to translations from different translators ⚠️ - ✔️French 100% - ❌Chinese Simplified 0% - ❌Chinese Traditional 0% - ❌German 0% - ❌Italian 0% - ❌Japanese 0% - ❌Korean 0% - ❌Polish 0% - ❌Portuguese 0% - ❌Portuguese, Brazilian 0% - ❌Russian 0% - ⚠️Spanish 86% : elGendo87

Publish.ChangeLog:
### Features * New Simple mode — the game's colors are grouped into a short palette (accent, backgrounds, texts, states...). Change one color and every related variable follows, keeping its lighter/darker shade and transparency. * Open a palette card to see its variables, each with a link to it in Advanced mode. * Variables edited by hand in Advanced mode keep their value. Click their lock to make them follow the palette again. * Palettes follow game updates: colors are recalculated automatically against the new game UI. * Identify — hover a palette, one of its variables or a color in Advanced mode, and the matching parts of the game UI blink. * Theme check — a banner shows the variables of a theme that no longer match the game (removed, broken reference, wrong value type...). "Clean up" removes them in one click, and Undo brings them back. * Import shows the same check before importing, and refuses themes made with a newer version of the mod. * Undo/Redo covers palette changes and Clean up, one step each. * New shortcut to open or close the panel (Ctrl+Shift+T by default, rebindable in Settings). * The panel button is now hidden in the main menu and the editor by default. Turn it back on in Settings; the shortcut opens the panel either way.
### Fixes * Themes now apply everywhere in the modern UI (some menu, tooltip and header colors kept the game value). * Advanced mode shows the default values of the interface you use (modern or legacy). * Better performance: dragging or resizing the panel and editing colors no longer drops FPS.
### Other * Theme files are now versioned. Older themes are upgraded when saved, with a backup of the original file.
